annotation.title_clean: The Transformative Impact of Artificial Intelligence and Robotics in Healthcare: Applications, Challenges, and Ethical Implications
annotation.title_en: The Transformative Impact of Artificial Intelligence and Robotics in Healthcare: Applications, Challenges, and Ethical Implications
annotation.venue: Saudi Journal of Medicine and Public Health
annotation.summary_en: Literature review of AI and robotics applications in healthcare, covering diagnostics, robotic surgery, socially assistive robots, rehabilitation and elder care. It notes challenges of data privacy, algorithm transparency and clinician training, and calls for collaboration among technologists, providers and policymakers, without detailed governance analysis.
key_provisions_or_claims: AI improves diagnostic accuracy, especially in medical imaging
Robotic surgery and socially assistive robots improve outcomes and ease caregiving burdens
Persistent challenges: data privacy, algorithm transparency, security and reliability of care robots
Healthcare professionals need training in AI technologies
Collaboration among technologists, clinicians and policymakers is needed
